Alienism.description: The Alienism faith is a group of related beliefs that hold that vastly powerful godlike beings live in the far reaches of space. The existence of these beings partially overlaps with neighboring dimensions and other periods of time. These beings are immensely powerful forces of an unimaginable nature, though generally malicious, who have a desire to rule over all living things. Alienism is an enigmatic faith. Unlike most Faith FX broad skills that use rituals to call the attention of benign powers and beseech their aid, Alienism uses rituals to channel the power of old gods without needing their attention or permission. Even those who work against these beings can use these rituals to great effect. Anyone dabbling in these powers risks undergoing psychological changes, and eventually even madness, due to the bizarre and unfathomable nature of the beings from which this power is drawn.
Alienism.name: Alienism
Alienism.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pgs. 36-37

Body Alteration.description: The Body Alteration Super Power FX broad skill is a collection of Super Power FX that alter a hero's form or how a hero interacts with other physical matter. Size changes, shape alteration, extra arms, stretching, invisibility, and passing through solid objects are all powers of this type. Depending upon the power, the hero may simply have an unusual body shape, have fine control over the elasticity and form of his tissues, or may be able to alter the consistency of his flesh on an atomic level. Body Alteration powers require either a high Will to initiate and control these changes or a high Constitution to endure the stresses they place upon the body.
Body Alteration.name: Body Alteration
Body Alteration.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 58

Brick.description: Brick powers physically toughen the hero's body, providing unstoppable defense and raw force.

Chi.description: The Chi Super Power FX broad skill represents enhancement to the character's body and mind brought about by discipline and training. Most sorts of fantastic martial arts movies and comic book characters that exhibit exceptional but not superpowered abilities can be modeled with Chi FX. Practitioners of Chi are very dedicated individuals. They have devoted their lives to a religion, a cause, or a form of martial art. Chi powers take years to develop, and so most characters are not able to pick them up during the course of a normal campaign. Some are more powerful versions of other abilities available to characters. Non-Chi characters can reproduce some of a Chi master's incredible abilities to a lesser extent through perks and rank benefits. Some Chi Super Power FX specialty skills note that no skill check is required for their use. These include skills that merely augment a hero's other skills, such as mighty leap (Athletics-jump) and power climb (Athletics-climb). The practitioner of Chi relies on the power of her body as well as her mind. Thus, Chi specialty skills are based on Strength or Will.

Druidism.description: The druidic faith is a belief that the earth is the mother and source of all life. The faith reveres the earth and other natural things, observing and maintaining the circle of life, death, and rebirth. The miracles of Druidism require a combination of understanding how the pathways of natural energy work and sufficient will to manipulate those pathways to result in physical changes.
Druidism.name: Druidism

Energy.description: The Energy Super Power FX broad skill deals mainly with the creation, destruction, and control of energy, including thermal (heat or cold), electrical, and radioactive energy. Beings with these abilities tend to be very impressive, throwing lightning bolts or shielding themselves in cloaks of fire, but also have a great potential to inflict damage. Like the Brick Super Power FX broad skill, the Energy FX broad skill can manifest in many different ways and result from varied story origins, such as lasers from an advanced body tank, the bolts from an electrokinetic mutant, or the breath of a creature whose home dimension is made of fire. Energy Super Power FX skills generally rely on the hero's Will to shape the energy, though a high Constitution is also useful.
Energy.name: Energy
Energy.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 64

Hatire.description: The Hatire faith developed in the STAR DRIVE campaign setting as a group of people who eschewed the use of technology and embraced the idea of hard work for the benefit of all in the community. This religion became somewhat popular and eventually had a following large enough to populate a planetary colony. During the exploration of their new planet, Haven, the Hatire discovered ancient ruins that spoke of a deity—called the Cosimir—worshiped by the planet's former inhabitants. This being was a proponent of purity of spirit, an ideal that the Hatire also held. The Hatire combined the worship of the Cosimir into their own religion and continued their work in their region of space. Reflecting the Hatire mores of perseverance, patience, and continuous striving, Hatire miracles are easier to invoke if some time is spent in prayer before invoking the miracle. If a Hatire priest spends an entire round in prayer before invoking the miracle, the priest enjoys a -1 step bonus to the miracle's skill check. If the priest can spend a full 10 minutes in prayer, he gains a -3 step bonus to invoke the miracle. The priest must maintain concentration during this time, or the miracle and any FX points used to activate it are lost. Any damage suffered during this period or any actions taken other than prayer immediately break concentration. The Hatire faith is a splinter group of a monotheistic religion. Therefore, the use of Hatire Faith FX requires strong Will and Personality Abilities similar to the Monotheism Faith FX, and its miracles are based on those two Ability Scores.
Hatire.name: Hatire
Hatire.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 43-44

Hemomancy.description: Hemomancy represents the forbidden school of blood magic. Spells rely on siphoning the biological life force of either the caster or touched victims, manipulating blood chemistry, blood pressure, and bio-organic flows. Cast on a creature of another species, it inflicts a +1 step penalty.

Illusion.description: The Illusion school of arcane magic specializes in tricking the senses of observers. Unlike physical transformations or energy manipulation, illusions alter light and sound waves, or plant sensory phantasms directly into the minds of targets. While these creations possess no actual physical mass or ability to inflict real structural damage, they are indistinguishable from reality unless closely investigated or exposed by supernatural senses.

Mesmerism.description: The Mesmerism school of arcane magic is dedicated to manipulating, controlling, and altering the minds, perceptions, and emotions of living subjects. Unlike illusion magic, which primarily alters external light and sound waves, mesmerism targets the neurological and spiritual pathways of the victim's brain directly. A skilled mesmerist can weave subtle suggestions into a target's thoughts, lull them into vulnerable trance states, command their physical movements, or shatter their mental resilience entirely.

Heightened Intelligence, Will, and Personality, rapid absorption of knowledge, and enhanced senses are all part of this broad skill. These powers are all based on superior will or cognitive ability and rely upon Will or Intelligence to function.

Movement.description: The Movement Super Power FX broad skill covers various special abilities that allow the user to move in nonstandard or accelerated ways. Superhuman speed, flight, rapid attacks, and even teleportation are possible with the specialty skills in this group. While flight and swimming are often granted due to simple physiological changes, such as wings or fins, and teleportation works by bending space or breaking dimensional barriers, the other sorts of powers under this broad skill usually originate from a highly accelerated metabolism or the ability to interact with the real world on a different time scale. Most Movement specialty skills do not require a skill check to use. Those that do require one rely on Constitution or Will to activate the power.

Movement.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 67-68

Necromancy.description:
Necromancy is classified as a highly specialized and challenging school of Arcane Magic FX. It centers entirely on the movement and manipulation of life energy, typically operating through living or dead physical shells, but occasionally acting independently of a physical body. Practitioners of this school do not require a specific religious or spiritual creed; their spells can forcibly call back a human spirit regardless of the nature of the afterlife to which that soul has fled.

Because life energy does not conform to the rigid physical laws constraining other forces of nature, practicing Necromancy requires a deep, clinical understanding of biological anatomy. Practicing this magic takes a severe toll on the arcanist's psyche and physical body, causing necromancers to grow increasingly reclusive and inhuman as their mastery over death expands.

Universal School Rules & Overarching Mechanics:
1. The Critical Failure Backfire Table: Necromancy is incredibly volatile. Each time a caster rolls a Critical Failure (a natural 20 on the control die) while attempting a Necromancy spell, they must make an immediate Personality feat check. Failure on the Check: The spell fizzles, and the necromancer permanently suffers one of the following flaws (determined randomly or selected by the GM): Poor Looks, Obsessed, or Phobia. These flaws are fully cumulative and can only be removed through standard character advancement means.
2. Life Force Substitution (Siphoning): When a necromancer exhausts their FX energy pool, they can substitute their own raw vitality to fuel their magic. The Cost: Substituting life force for 1 FX energy point instantly inflicts a loss of 2 fatigue points upon the caster.
3. Trapping Spirits in a Life Battery: A life battery is a specially prepared magical container used to store the siphoned life force of a necromancer's victims. Fueling Spells: Each mortal point of the victim trapped within the life battery provides the caster with 1 FX energy point. The Dissipation Risk: Every time the caster draws energy from the life battery, the trapped spirit must pass a Stamina-endurance skill check or dissipate forever. There is no mechanical way to detect if a once-full battery has run dry other than attempting to draw FX energy from it.
4. The Xenobiology Chemistry Penalty (+5 Step): Because Necromancy is intimately tied to physical anatomy, casting these spells on creatures whose basic chemistry differs from the caster's own (such as a human necromancer casting Animate Dead on a silicon-based alien) inflicts a severe +5 step penalty to the skill check. Reduction: Possessing the Medical Science-xenomedicine specialty reduces this penalty to a +3 step penalty at Rank 1, which then scales downward based on the specialty's normal rank benefits.
Necromancy.meta: Cost: 10 skill points / Governing Abilities: Intelligence, Constitution / Source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 31

Shamanism.description: The shaman is a holy man, a guide and adviser to a tribe who is gifted with the ability to send her consciousness into the spirit world at will and interact with the creatures there. This ability to accomplish what most can only do accidentally in dreams gives the shaman strength in the spirit world, allowing her to rouse the spirits of the dead, see the future, and enlist the aid of animal spirits.
Shamanism.meta: Cost: 10 skill points / Governing Abilities: Will, Intelligence
Shamanism.name: Shamanism
Shamanism.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 46

Taoism.description: Taoism is a belief system focused on living in perfect harmony with the "Tao" (the Way), the fundamental flow and life force of the universe. Practitioners emphasize balance, naturalness, and internal alchemy, learning to master their own spiritual energy (Chi) to perform exceptional feats of physical and mental resilience. Through dedication and alignment with natural laws, Taoist priests can manipulate their inner energies to heal wounds, project protective spirals of energy, withstand hostile external conditions, or neutralize harmful forces without active resistance.
Taoism.meta: Cost: 13 skill points / Governing Abilities: Will, Personality
Taoism.name: Taoism
Taoism.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 50

Voodoo.description: The Voodoo faith is a syncretic religion centered around the veneration of and communication with the Loa—powerful spirit intermediaries that govern various aspects of nature, humanity, and the cosmos. Practitioners, known as houngans (priests) and mambos (priestesses), use ritual music, dance, and sacred symbols (veves) to enter altered states of consciousness, allowing the Loa to temporarily "ride" or possess their physical bodies to dispense wisdom, protection, or judgment. Rather than viewing the spirit world as separate from reality, the Voodoo faith treats both realms as continuously overlapping matrices. Through these ritual alignments, practitioners can create powerful protective charms, invoke deep physical restoration, cure toxic ailments, or direct targeted spiritual afflictions against hostile forces.
Voodoo.meta: Cost: 12 skill points / Governing Abilities: Will, Personality
Voodoo.name: Voodoo

Incantation.name: Incantation

Enochian.description: Enochian magic reaches the celestial and angelic dimensions rather than the infernal ones Diabolism calls on, and its workings are protective and invocatory: warding a place, calling for aid, unmaking what somebody else has bound. Alone among the arcane schools it is governed by Will and nothing else -- every spell under it is cast on Will, so the school is a pure Will discipline where Diabolism leans on Personality and Hermeticism on Intelligence.
Enochian.name: Enochian
Enochian.source: Dark Matter Campaign Setting, Chapter 4: Arcana, pp. 52-53, 55.

Animate dead.description: The staple spell of classical necromancers, used to animate corpses to serve as mindless servants. Imbues dead bodies with life energy to allow movement and basic reactions. The spell's capacity is tied directly to brain mass. It can revive a single human-sized brain creature (including human, fraal, sesheyan, t'sa, and weren) or multiple creatures whose combined brain mass does not exceed a human's (such as 2 dogs, 3 cats, or 20 rats). Animated zombies obey simple, direct-verb commands ("Attack," "Guard," "Walk"). The target corpse must be within 30 meters when animated. Decay Penalties: The target corpse's state of decay penalizes the success check: +1 step for bodies dead 1–6 weeks; +2 steps for bodies dead 6–12 weeks; bodies dead over 24 weeks are unsuitable. Anatomical Synergy: A necromancer with Medical Science-medical knowledge specialty gains a check bonus of -1 step at Rank 2, -2 steps at Rank 5, -3 steps at Rank 8, and -4 steps at Rank 12. Duration: Ordinary success = 1 day; Good success = 1 week; Amazing success = 1 month. The necromancer can control a maximum number of active zombies equal to their Animate Dead specialty skill rank. Combat Forms Added: This spell does not grant the caster direct combat statistics; instead, it summons a physical Zombie creature that acts as an independent combatant with its own claw attacks and physical armor.

At any time during the miracle's effect, the houngan or mambo can choose to have Ayza intervene in his or her favor. Bend space.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Modifiers: Any mortal being undergoing this transport must make a mental resolve skill check with a -2 step bonus or temporarily suffer the penalties described in the Alienism description (Gain one flaw, and lose 1 point from Intelligence) lasting for d4 days. All those to be transported must be in physical contact with one another. This miracle causes space to behave in a manner inconsistent with normal geometry, allowing the alienist to travel vast distances in the blink of an eye. Travel in this fashion is instantaneous in terms of this reality, although to those traveling it seems to take anywhere from a few seconds to 2 hours (Roll 3d20 and multiply them together for the number of internal subjective seconds). The sights and sounds experienced during transit are traumatic. The alienist can transport up to 4 people including himself to any point within 100 kilometers that he has previously seen.

Body and soul.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: Resistance modifiers do not alter the righteous wrath skill check. Righteous wrath ignores any armor worn by the targets. Any target with cybernetics or other artificial implants suffers an additional 2 points of stun damage, while those of the Hatire faith reduce all damage suffered by 2 points. (The damage to cybernetics users does not apply to mechalus equipped with only their free cybernetic gear.) Full Text: This miracle directs a barrage of mystical energy at the priest's opponents. The priest makes a single skill check against all targets within a 5-meter-radius sphere centered on any point within 30 meters of him. All within this area suffer damage of d4s/d6s/d8s (En/O).

Call the sky father.description: Changes local weather in a 30-meter-radius area centered on the druid for 10 minutes. The druid can warm or cool the air, disperse or gather small clouds, speed or slow wind, or cause rain to fall or cease, but cannot create weather inappropriate for the terrain and climate. The check is always complex with one roll per round. Common seasonal weather requires an Ordinary complex check, unusual or adjacent-season weather requires Good, and any possible weather for the terrain regardless of season requires Amazing. The Gamemaster sets exact successes required. If conditions support lightning, the druid may spend 1 additional FX energy point to strike a target within 30 meters with a weaker lightning hazard; the target receives a -2 step bonus to the Constitution feat check. This lightning can be used no more than once per minute.
Call the sky father.meta: Manual: Call the Sky Father; Faith FX - Druidism; Specialty cost 5; Ability INT; Transform miracle; 2 FX energy points; Beyond Science p. 40.
Call the sky father.name: Call the sky father

Child of the earth mother.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: Material Restrictions: Invoking this miracle on worked stone (like a statue) inflicts a +1 step penalty. Invoking it on manufactured aggregate stone-like material (like bricks or concrete) inflicts a +2 step penalty. Duration Boosting: Each additional FX energy point spent at invocation increases the elemental's duration by 50%. Full Text: This miracle focuses energy into a piece of stone, giving it mobility and limited intelligence. The created creature, called an earth elemental, is slow but strong. It unquestioningly obeys the orders of the druid who summoned it. The elemental can be used to move objects, dig or fill holes, act as an ally in combat, or perform similar raw physical tasks. The miracle lasts 10 minutes plus 10 minutes for every degree of success of the skill check.
Child of the earth mother.meta: Cost: 5 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Child of the earth mother.name: Child of the earth mother
Child of the earth mother.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 41

Circle of the thousand broken angles.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Modifiers: The circle lasts 5 rounds. No creatures of Alienism origin can cross the circle, nor can any of their FX powers do so. However, such a creature can break the circle by spending five times as many FX energy points as were used to build it. This miracle wards against the servitors of the Alienism powers. It can be used to guard a person from an external threat or to contain a creature. Although it costs only 1 FX energy point to create the 2-meter-radius circle, the alienist can expend additional points at the time of its creation to make a stronger barrier.
Circle of the thousand broken angles.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Conjure miracle (1 FX energy point)

Clamor.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: Also known as Cacophony. This spell allows the illusionist to create a localized auditory trick, manufacturing sounds that can range from a hushed whisper right next to a target's ear to the roaring approach of a military transport vehicle. The source of the sound can be placed anywhere within 30 meters and can move about within that radius. A target can make an Awareness-perception check to realize the sound has no physical source.
Clamor.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Conjure spell (1 FX energy point)
Clamor.name: Clamor

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the sound can achieve deafening volumes, forcing anyone within a 2-meter radius to make a physical resolve check or be dazed for 1 round.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the max radius of the sound's positioning extends to 60 meters.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the illusionist can introduce high-frequency distortion, causing targets within 3 meters of the focal point to suffer a +1 step penalty to listening checks.

Clamor.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 29

Conceal.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: Also known as Concealment. The caster bends light and ambient frequencies around a single non-living object, a minor structure, or a person within 2 meters, rendering it functionally invisible to normal visual scrutiny. Anyone looking directly at the concealed target must pass an Awareness-perception check with a +2 step penalty to notice the subtle visual shimmering.

Confidence.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This miracle bolsters the inner conviction and self-assurance of the priest or a touched ally, reinforcing their psychological framework against external manipulation or fear. Full Text: By centering their thoughts on the absolute harmony of the universe, the priest instills unshakeable clarity and focus. The target gains a -2 step bonus to all mental resolve and interaction checks for the duration of the scene, rendering them highly resilient against intimidation, mesmerism, or direct psychic coercion.

Dirge of the null-mind.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Modifiers: At the start of each round after the miracle is invoked, those within the 10-meter area of effect must make a Resolve-mental resolve skill check or suffer 1 point of fatigue damage and temporarily lose 1 point from Intelligence and Will. Targets whose Intelligence or Will drops to 0 fall unconscious until the miracle ends. This miracle causes a repetitive sound to begin. This sound instills lethargy and a sense of vapidity into all within 10 meters except the alienist. Fatigue damage must be recovered normally. The dirge lasts 1 round for every degree of success of the skill check.

Disrupt technology.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: Any mechalus or similar being targeted by this miracle also suffers a +2 step penalty on all actions including action checks due to a temporary shutdown of interior nanites and electronic systems. Such beings cannot use their natural ability to link with computers. Full Text: This miracle causes one target within 30 meters of the priest that relies on electronic circuits (including most cybernetics) to stop functioning for the duration of the miracle. Examples of targets that may be affected include a computer, a control station for a ship, or a person with one or more cybernetic implants. The last case would render the implants nonfunctional but not otherwise affect the person. The miracle lasts 1 round plus 1 round for every degree of success of the skill check.
Disrupt technology.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Disrupt technology.name: Disrupt technology
Disrupt technology.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 44

Dominate.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This powerful spell allows the mesmerist to strip away a victim's free will and seize direct command of their nervous system and motor actions. This spell triggers an immediate contested roll against the target's mental resolve score. If successful, the victim must execute the caster's telepathic or spoken orders explicitly. Commands that directly force self-destruction grant the target an immediate secondary check with a -2 step bonus to break the spell.

Dominate.name: Dominate

rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the target no longer receives a defense bonus or secondary check when ordered to perform hazardous tasks.

Full Text: The dreamwalking miracle gives the shaman the ability to send her consciousness outside her body and perceive distant events, seeing and hearing locations within 1 kilometer.

It generates curative effects and heals damage based on the result of the skill check. Full Text: By controlling their respiration to match primal baseline values, the user accelerates metabolic recovery and purifies their internal tissues. A successful check restores stun or wound damage based on the level of success achieved.

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the hero can survive completely without external oxygen intake for up to 1 hour while executing this technique.

The target must pass a mental resolve check to resist the impulse. Blinding rage forces the target to attack the nearest creature regardless of alignment; panic forces an immediate tactical retreat; sorrow applies a +2 step penalty to all actions.

rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the step bonus to action checks improves to -2.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the mesmerist can project this mental encouragement to all allies within a 5-meter radius.

Energy Blast.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Modifier: The target's Dexterity resistance modifier applies to this skill check. This power allows the character to shoot blasts of energy from his hands, eyes, or mouth. The player of a hero with this broad skill should choose a single type of energy to be wielded from the energy types list (Cold, Electricity, Fire/heat/plasma, Gravity, Light, Radiation, Sound). The energy blast has a range of 60 meters. The hero can fire no more than one blast per phase, and each blast costs 1 FX energy point. A successful check indicates the damage inflicted: d4+1w/d6+1w/d4m (En/O). A character who selects this power as always active constantly emits beams of energy and cannot shut them off. Special equipment—such as an energy containment suit, a high-tech visor, or protective gloves—is necessary to keep the character from destroying everything around himself. Even with this option, the hero must make a normal energy blast skill check to attack, and Failure indicates a miss.

Weakening or opening the field to attack makes the protected individual vulnerable from that general direction. This power allows the hero to create a protective barrier that causes attacks to deflect away from anything sheltered by it. The energy field can fully protect either the user or another single person of weren size or smaller within 30 meters. Maintaining the field requires no actions, but switching it to another target takes an action. Each activation of the energy field lasts 1 minute (5 rounds).

rank_benefits.3: At ranks 3, 6, and 9, the character can make a larger energy field, allowing her to protect one additional person at each of these ranks.

Energy Field.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pgs. 65-66

Energy Resistance.description: Governing Ability: Constitution (CON). Player Notes: Grants Ordinary toughness armor of d4+1 against the selected type of energy. Checked first before damage spills over to normal armor types. This power allows the character to resist one type of energy without harm. Damage resisted with this power does not cause secondary damage. Each use of this power lasts 1 minute per degree of success.
Energy Resistance.meta: Cost: 2 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Active or 1 FX energy point
Energy Resistance.name: Energy Resistance

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the toughness of the energy resistance becomes Good.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the hero's protection increases to d6+1 against the selected form of energy.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the hero's protection increases to d8+1 against the selected form of energy.

Energy Resistance.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 66

Energy Sheath/Form.description: This power has two forms: Either the character can surround herself with a particular type of energy, or she can transform herself and all equipment carried into a mostly solid form of that energy.
Energy Sheath/Form.meta: Active or 1 or 3 FX energy points. This skill can't be used untrained.
Energy Sheath/Form.name: Energy Sheath/Form

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the armor toughness and damage category improve to Good.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the armor increases...
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the damage increases to d4 points of wound damage for energy sheath or d6 points of wound damage for energy form.

Energy drain.description: A targeted beam of negative energy that directly disrupts a victim's life force. The caster shoots a beam of black light that unerringly hits any chosen target within 30 meters. Damage Matrix: d6+1s / d8+2s / d4+1f (En/O). Because the damage directly disrupts life energy rather than physical flesh, physical armor does not protect against it, though magical wards and defensive shields apply. Combat Forms Added: Attack Form: Adds an elite ranged Attack Form (Range: 30 meters) that completely bypasses physical armor and inflicts heavy Stun and Fatigue damage.
Energy drain.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (2 FX energy points)
Energy drain.name: Energy drain

rank_benefits.9: Rank 9 (Increased Damage): Damage scales up to d8+2s / d12+3s / d4+3f.

Energy spiral.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: This creates an active outward projection of structured Chi to deflect kinetic or energy impacts. Full Text: The priest externalizes their inner life force into a spinning vortex or radiant sphere of protective Chi. This energetic barrier surrounds the priest or a chosen target within 10 meters, actively neutralizing or deflecting incoming vectors. The energy spiral absorbs damage up to a specific intensity, acting as an exceptional buffer against LI, HI, or En attacks.
Energy spiral.meta: Cost: 5 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Conjure miracle (2 FX energy points)
Energy spiral.name: Energy spiral

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, any melee attacker who hits the barrier triggers a structural backlash, sustaining d4 points of stun damage (En/O).
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the defensive barrier adds a +1 step penalty to all incoming ranged attacks targeted at the protected individual.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the energy spiral can be expanded to protect up to three contiguous targets standing within 3 meters of each other.

Energy spiral.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 52

Erzuli's fetish.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: Erzuli is the Loa of love, beauty, and human passion. Imprinting her spiritual frequency onto a handheld item or piece of jewelry creates a functional fetish that dramatically enhances the bearer's charisma and charm. The individual holding or wearing the fetish gains a -2 step bonus to all Interaction-charm and Interaction-seduction checks.
Erzuli's fetish.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Conjure miracle (1 FX energy point)
Erzuli's fetish.name: Erzuli's fetish

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the fetish directly grants a temporary +1 point to the bearer's base Personality score while held.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the fetish remains charged and active for up to 12 hours before naturally dissipating.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the -2 step bonus expands to encompass all Interaction-based specialty skills.

Erzuli's fetish.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 54

Everyman.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: This subtle but highly effective illusion shifts the target's perception of the caster, making them appear completely unremarkable and forgettable. While active, the caster simply blends into any crowd or environment as long as they do not take overt or aggressive actions. Anyone attempting to remember the caster's face or specific identifying details later suffers a +2 step penalty to their Intelligence or Awareness skill checks. The illusion lasts for the duration of the scene or until the caster initiates combat.
Everyman.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Everyman.name: Everyman

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the spell actively deflects mechanical surveillance; cameras and recording devices capture only a blurred, generic humanoid shape.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the memory-clouding effect is stronger; observers suffer a +3 step penalty to recall the caster.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the illusion holds even if the caster speaks or interacts briefly with others (such as ordering a drink or asking for directions).

Everyman.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 30

Exorcism.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This is handled as an extended complex check where target entities use their mental resolve to resist. Full Text: This miracle involves a long, complex process that can banish demons and evil spirits from the physical world or otherwise rid a host of a possessing foreign presence.
Exorcism.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (2 FX energy points)
Exorcism.name: Exorcism

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, this improves to a -3 step bonus.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the hero receives a -1 step bonus to exorcism skill checks.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, this improves to a -2 step bonus.

Exorcism.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 45

Extra limb.description: The user has an extra FX-powered manipulative limb, such as prehensile hair or a telekinetic hand. If chosen as active, this skill can represent an extra arm or a prehensile tail. The hero can command the extra limb to perform any action her hands could do. It is considered to be an off hand and thus suffers a +2 step penalty to any action. Using the extra limb simultaneously with one of the hero's normal limbs inflicts the penalties listed under the Two Actions at Once section in Chapter 3: Heroes in Action in the Player's Handbook. If the hero uses the extra limb at the same time she uses both of her hands, the third action receives a +6 step penalty. The Ambidextrous perk reduces any penalty for using multiple limbs to 0/+2 (or 0/+2/+4 for three limbs) regardless of the nature of the limbs. Each activation of the extra limb lasts for 10 minutes.
Extra limb.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Extra limb.name: Extra limb

rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, improved Control: At ranks 3, 6, 9, and 12, the penalty for using the FX limb is reduced by one step.

Extra limb.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 58

Eyes of the dark ones.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Modifiers: Lasts 10 minutes per degree of success of the skill check. Reveals all hidden elements within 30 meters. This miracle lets the alienist see things that are concealed by arcane or technological means. Any sort of device or FX that hides something from sight through mental deception, warping light rays, or any other means is useless against this miracle, which reveals all such objects within 30 meters of the alienist and limns them with a sickly greenish glow in his sight. Occasionally even inhabitants and scenery of nearby dimensions are revealed in a limited fashion in locations where the barriers between dimensions are thin.
Eyes of the dark ones.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Augur miracle (1 FX energy point)
Eyes of the dark ones.name: Eyes of the Dark Ones
Eyes of the dark ones.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 39

Flying.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Modifiers: Normal penalties for taking actions while gliding or flying apply per TABLE P11: COMBAT MOVEMENT EFFECTS in the Player's Handbook. Hovering takes no concentration and inflicts no penalty to actions. Opting for permanent active wings drops the always-active pool reduction cost from 3 to 2 points. This power allows the character to fly or glide at the appropriate combat movement rate. This power uses 1 FX point per 10 minutes of use. If this power is chosen as always active, the hero has the option of having physical wings to provide flight. These wings can resemble those of birds, bats, insects, or something more exotic. A winged character cannot hover. Characters with this power should consider learning the Acrobatics-flight specialty skill, since this power itself grants no particular maneuverability.
Flying.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Active or 1 FX energy point (No skill check required)
Flying.name: Flying

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the character's fly and glide rates increase to four times the base rates.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the character's fly and glide rates increase to two times the base rates.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the character's fly and glide rates increase to three times the base rates.

Flying.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 68

Focus.description: Much like the Stamina-resist pain skill, the focus Chi power allows the user to push beyond physical and mental pain and trauma to act as if those things simply didn't exist for a time. When this power is activated, all penalties from a dazed state, torture, mortal damage, fatigue damage, poison, and disease are ignored for the purpose of determining what step penalties the Chi user must take when performing an action. Total loss of stun, wound, mortal, or fatigue points has the normal effect on the hero. A hero could be suffering from 3 points of mortal damage, 2 points of fatigue, a terminal illness, and a paralytic poison, and she could still perform all normal actions without penalty. Situational penalties not related to the character's physical or mental state, such as performing surgery on an alien or hacking into a bank computer, still apply. This power lasts 4 phases. At the end of that time it can be automatically extended for 1 FX energy point.
Focus.meta: 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Focus.name: Focus

rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the focus lasts 5 rounds. It lasts 5 minutes.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, 30 minutes.

Focus.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 63

Forgetfulness.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: The mesmerist wipes a specific short-term memory or a block of recent time from the target's consciousness. The target must pass a mental resolve check to resist the psychic intrusion. A successful casting erases up to the last 5 minutes of the victim's immediate memory, replacing the gap with a hazy, indistinct blur. The victim will not remember encountering the caster or the events that just transpired.
Forgetfulness.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Forgetfulness.name: Forgetfulness

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the spell can erase up to an entire week of memories. The erasure is permanent unless actively restored by an Amazing success using a psychic or FX restorative power.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the mesmerist can erase up to 1 hour of recent memory.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the memory wipe extends to a full 24-hour period, or it can be used to surgically remove a specific memory of a single event or person from the target's past.

Forgetfulness.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 32

Fortitude.description: An infusion of raw life energy that temporarily bolsters a creature's physical threshold. Augments a living target's durability ratings with temporary health boxes. The caster must either target themselves or touch the recipient. Incoming damage is marked off in these extra boxes first. Fortitude Durability Gains: Ordinary Success: Grants +2 Stun / +1 Wound / 0 Mortal / 0 Fatigue temporary boxes. Good Success: Grants +3 Stun / +2 Wound / +1 Mortal / 0 Fatigue temporary boxes. Amazing Success: Grants +4 Stun / +3 Wound / +2 Mortal / +2 Fatigue temporary boxes. Limitations: This spell cannot be stacked on a single target, nor does it revive unconscious characters or resurrect dead ones. The spell terminates immediately when all extra boxes are consumed or after 10 minutes (whichever comes first). Combat Forms Added: Defense Form: Adds a temporary Defense Form (vitality shielding) to the caster or a touched ally, absorbing incoming physical or energy damage before normal health tracks are touched.
Fortitude.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Fortitude.name: Fortitude

rank_benefits.4: Rank 4 (Increased Fortitude): The durability increase goes up by 1 additional box in each category (e.g., Ordinary becomes 3s/2w/1m/1f).
rank_benefits.8: Rank 8: Durability increase goes up by 2 additional boxes in each category.
rank_benefits.12: Rank 12: Durability increase goes up by 3 additional boxes in each category.

Fusillade.description: Governing Ability: Constitution (CON). Modifiers: Activating this power does not take an action. Attempting to use this power in a phase earlier than the hero's action check result applies a +1 step penalty to the fusillade skill check. This power can only be attempted once per round whether successful or not. Takes 1 point of fatigue damage after combat for every extra action taken. This power gives the character the ability to attack more often during combat. During combat, the player rolls an action check as normal. However, the hero can make one extra attack during any phase by spending 1 FX energy point and making a successful fusillade skill check. For example, a hero with an Ordinary action check result can try to activate this power in the Amazing or Good phase at a +1 step penalty to attack early, or make an extra attack in either the Ordinary or Marginal phase after taking his normal action.
Fusillade.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / 1 FX energy point
Fusillade.name: Fusillade

rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the character can use this power up to two times per round, although only one extra action can be taken in any given phase.

Fusillade.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 68

Genius.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Modifiers: When active, grants the hero a -2 step bonus to Knowledge-deduce skill checks as well as any Knowledge skill checks made to determine specific campaign information. This power greatly enhances a hero's powers of deduction, reasoning, analysis, and memory. This power lasts for 1 hour.
Genius.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Active or 1 FX energy point
Genius.name: Genius

rank_benefits.10: At rank 10, the analysis step bonus increases to -2.
rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the hero can select a third broad skill and receive the same bonus.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the hero can select an Intelligence-based broad skill. While genius is active, the hero receives a -1 step bonus to all skill checks made using that broad skill or its specialty skills.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, a hero who studies a situation (such as a battle, a puzzle, a secured building, and so forth) for at least 5 rounds (1 minute) gains a -1 step bonus on action checks or complex skill checks made in relation to that situation. This benefit lasts throughout the current situation. For instance, if a battle were studied, the effect would last until the battle ended.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the hero can select a second broad skill and gain a similar bonus.

Genius.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 66

The larvae possess a +3 resistance modifier vs. mental attacks and an always active form of eyes of the dark ones. This miracle summons one or more sluglike alien creatures that appear at the alienist's feet and attack targets indicated by the alienist. Gris-gris.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: A gris-gris is a small, specialized charm bag combining token materials to manifest a targeted intent. It can be deployed in two configurations determined at the time of creation: a protective configurations that shields an ally, or a hostile configuration that serves as a hex against an enemy. If protective, it grants a +1 bonus to all resistance modifiers against incoming hostile FX or psionic manipulation. If configured as a hex, the intended target must pass a mental resolve check or suffer a +1 step penalty to all action checks for the duration of the scene.

Gris-gris.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 54

Growing.description: This power allows the hero and all gear he wears or carries to grow in height and mass. The character's height and mass increase by 50%. The character's Strength is considered 2 points higher for purposes of melee damage, lifting capacity, and breaking objects. As a larger target, the hero also suffers a +1 step penalty to his defense against all attacks. Gear that grows with the character functions normally (a blaster pistol still does its normal damage, armor still provides its normal protection). Active growth lasts 10 minutes.
Growing.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.

Impact Conversion.description: This unusual power gives the character the ability to absorb kinetic energy and transform it into enhanced physical power. Whenever the hero is struck by an attack that delivers LI- or HI-type damage, roll d4 and subtract the result from the base damage inflicted regardless of the firepower of the attack. If the attack inflicts mortal damage, subtract 2 from this die roll for the purposes of damage reduction (to a minimum of 1 point), but retain the full value for the power's secondary effect (listed below). Apply the reduced damage total as normal, including calculating armor protection and any secondary damage inflicted. This energy is immediately converted into physical might. The hero can add the number rolled to the damage inflicted by her next melee attack. This attack expends the extra energy whether successful or not. Multiple absorptions are cumulative; however, any points remaining at the end of the 5-round duration are lost. If the power is selected as always active, no absorbed energy remains for longer than 5 rounds.

Invisibility.description: This power allows the hero to become invisible to all sorts of visual detection including infrared, radar, and other sorts of electromagnetic-based scanning. Anyone attempting to locate the hero using one of these senses or by using an Awareness-perception or investigate check suffers a +4 step penalty to do so. Attacking an invisible character is usually done as a wild swing. The invisible character gains a -3 step bonus to stealth skill checks. The hero's clothing and gear become invisible along with him, provided that they are touching him when he becomes invisible. Items picked up do not become invisible, and things dropped become visible immediately. The power lasts 10 minutes.

sections.body: Adds an active crowd-controlling **Debuff Form**.

Lightning Speed.description: Governing Ability: Constitution (CON). Modifiers: Costs 1 FX point per 10 minutes of use. Instantly doubles sprint, run, and walk rates upon purchase. This power allows the hero to greatly increase her running speed. Purchasing this skill immediately doubles the character's sprint, run, and walk movement rates.
Lightning Speed.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Active or 1 FX energy point (No skill check required)
Lightning Speed.name: Lightning Speed

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the hero can run across liquid or other nonsolid surfaces, including snow, quicksand, or water. She moves as far as her adjusted run rate in meters before starting to sink.
rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, the hero's sprint, run, and walk rates increase to three times the base rates.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, the hero's sprint, run, and walk rates increase to four times the base rates.
rank_benefits.9: At rank 9, the hero's sprint, run, and walk rates increase to five times the base rates.

Lightning Speed.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 68

Loa of healing.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This specialty acts as the primary therapeutic avenue of the faith, calling upon restorative entities to mend broken flesh. Direct skin-to-skin touch is mandatory to channel the effect. Restoration scales explicitly by success: an Ordinary success heals 2 stun or 1 wound point; a Good success heals 4 stun or 2 wounds; an Amazing success heals 6 stun, 3 wounds, or 1 mortal point.
Loa of healing.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Loa of healing.name: Loa of healing

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the spiritual cleansing completely neutralizes aggressive systemic toxins, biological venom, or heavy internal infections alongside its standard physical mending.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, the core restorative capacity of the miracle is increased across all brackets by 50% (rounded down).

Loa of healing.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 55

Mighty Leap.description: With this power, the Chi user can make tremendous leaps. By spending 1 FX energy point, the character can leap twice as far as the values listed under the Athletics-jump skill. The hero also suffers minimum damage (1 point of stun damage) from a Marginal success and only d4 points of stun damage from a Critical Failure.
Mighty Leap.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained. No skill check required.
Mighty Leap.name: Mighty Leap

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the multiplier for the character's jumping distance increases to five times normal.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the multiplier for the character's jumping distance increases to three times normal.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the multiplier for the character's jumping distance increases to four times normal.

Mighty Leap.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pgs. 63-64

Mindshatter.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: The caster launches a devastating, unstructured wave of pure psychic trauma directly into the target's consciousness within 20 meters. This attack bypasses standard physical armor entirely. A successful strike deals mental damage scaling by success tier: Ordinary deals d4s; Good deals d6s; Amazing deals d4w points of direct damage to the target's durability tracking.
Mindshatter.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Mindshatter.name: Mindshatter

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, achieving an Amazing success leaves the target completely unconscious for d4 rounds following the mental trauma.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the psychic damage profile improves to d4+1s/d6+1s/d4+1w.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the range of the psychic crushing vector extends to 40 meters.

Mindshatter.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 33

Moving pictures.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: The illusionist designs a dynamic, moving three-dimensional visual illusion within a 3-meter radius space up to 30 meters away. The image follows a pre-programmed sequence or can be actively directed by the caster spending a phase of concentration. It produces no heat, sound, or physical impact, and passes through solid matter harmlessly.
Moving pictures.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Conjure spell (2 FX energy points)
Moving pictures.name: Moving pictures

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the inversion is so structurally flawless that observers must actively interact with or pass through it to trigger a perception check to disbelieve.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the illusion can be synchronized to include realistic, low-fidelity audio (requires combining with the Clamor specialty skill traits).
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the maximum radius of the illusory display expands to 6 meters.

Moving pictures.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 30

Mummy's curse.description: A touch-delivered biological blight that initiates a permanent, wasting disease. The caster touches a target, who must immediately roll a Resolve-physical resolve check. If the target fails, they immediately contract a magical blight, beginning at the Ill stage of a disease. The AFFLICTION Progress: The target's condition fluctuates between Ill and Terminally Ill. Because of the magical nature of the curse, Constitution feat checks can never allow the victim to recover beyond the Ill stage. They are trapped in this wasting loop until they die or the curse is lifted. The Siphoned Cost: To maintain this blight, the caster must feed it with their own life force, sustaining 1 point of Wound damage when cast. This Wound point cannot be healed by any means while the Mummy's Curse remains active on the victim. The caster can lift the curse at will, and the curse terminates automatically upon the caster's death. Combat Forms Added: Debuff/Attack Form: Adds a dangerous touch-based Attack Form that bypasses physical armor to infect a target with a terminal, wasting sickness.
Mummy's curse.meta: Cost: 5 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Mummy's curse.name: Mummy's curse

Negate the spirit.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This defensive miracle disrupts foreign spiritual interference, driving out malevolent possessions, energetic anchors, or active curses. When targeted at an entity actively possessing an ally, it triggers an immediate contested check against that entity's mental resolve score to banish it. If targeted directly at a hostile spellcaster or priest, an Amazing success temporarily jams their spiritual frequency, severing their connection to their FX energy pool for d4 rounds.
Negate the spirit.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (2 FX energy points)
Negate the spirit.name: Negate the spirit

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, achieving an Amazing success on the check permanently severs complex extra-dimensional curses, genetic hexes, or deep spiritual bindings.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, a successfully cleansed ally receives a +2 bonus to all resistance modifiers against subsequent possession or mental control attempts for 24 hours.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the banishment wave expands, operating as a 5-meter radius burst centered on the priest to disrupt multiple minor spectral entities.

Negate the spirit.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 56

Not doing.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: Rooted in the philosophy of Wu Wei, this miracle allows the character to avoid harmful outcomes by blending seamlessly into the ambient flow of a situation rather than actively countering it. Full Text: The priest embraces complete stillness and non-resistance, allowing incoming kinetic forces or hostile social pressures to roll off them harmlessly. By matching the exact tempo and structure of their surroundings, the hero achieves a remarkable passive defense, adding substantial step penalties to an opponent's aggressive initiatives or complex tracking maneuvers.
Not doing.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Not doing.name: Not doing

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the character can phase their physical presence into absolute synchronization with the room, gaining a -2 step bonus to stealth checks even in plain sight.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the hero receives a -1 step bonus to defensive rolls while taking no active offensive actions.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, any active detection or tracking check directed at the hero suffers a +2 step penalty while they maintain this state.

Not doing.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 52

Peace.description: This miracle projects a calming aura of tranquility that quells anger and violence in the immediate vicinity, bringing the area into closer alignment with the Tao.
Peace.name: Peace

rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, increased Area: At ranks 4, 8, and 12, the radius of the peaceful aura expands.

Permeation.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This miracle alters physical interaction dynamics, allowing the priest to blend into solid structures. Full Text: Tapping into the atomic and energetic space between dense materials, the priest allows their physical form to naturally seep or slip into stone, earth, or wood. While permeating a structure, the priest is highly protected from standard physical combat vectors, though they must maintain strict breath control to avoid becoming trapped.
Permeation.meta: Cost: 2 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Permeation.name: Permeation

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the priest can seamlessly bring up to 10 kilograms of personal equipment or gear with them through the permeated barrier.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the duration of structural permeation increases to 5 minutes.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the priest can move through basic solid materials at half their normal walk rate.

Permeation.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 53

Phasing.description: This FX allows the hero to shift his body's molecules out of phase with those of his environment, allowing him to pass through solid objects. While phased, the character ignores physical attacks, but energy-based attacks affect him normally. The character can only walk while phased and cannot pass through objects with a toughness greater than Poor. It takes one phase to pass through 1 meter of solid material. If the hero solidifies while inside a solid object, he takes d4+1 mortal damage and is pushed to the nearest open space. The duration of this power is 1 minute.
Phasing.meta: 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Phasing.name: Phasing

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, improved Phasing: At rank 12, the hero can move through any object of up to Amazing toughness. Increased Movement: At rank 12, the hero can sprint.
rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, increased Duration: At rank 3, duration increases to 5 minutes. At rank 9 this increases to 30 minutes.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, improved Phasing: At rank 6, the hero can move through objects of Good toughness. Increased Movement: At rank 6, the hero can run while phased.
rank_benefits.9: At rank 9, increased Duration: At rank 3, duration increases to 5 minutes. At rank 9 this increases to 30 minutes.

Phasing.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 59

Power Climb.description: This power allows the user to climb up seemingly impossible surfaces or to move rapidly up surfaces that would normally require time to climb. If the surface is climbable by someone with the Athletics-climb skill without a penalty, then the character can simply run up the surface. She can reach a maximum height of twice her walk movement rate in meters before she must find a more horizontal surface upon which to rest or she falls. The character can also scale surfaces that have a step penalty to climb by climbing in a more normal manner. When doing this, she climbs at twice the rate listed under the climb skill. Each use of this power lasts 1 round.
Power Climb.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point per round. This skill can't be used untrained. No skill check required.
Power Climb.name: Power Climb

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the character's multiplier for both running up walls and climbing increases to five times the listed values.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the character's multiplier for both running up walls and climbing increases to three times the listed values.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the character's multiplier for both running up walls and climbing increases to four times the listed values.

Power Climb.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 84 / 64

Power Strike.description: This ability allows the user to focus his will into one unarmed attack and to greatly increase its power and accuracy. The user gains a -1 step bonus on his next unarmed melee attack and inflicts 2 additional points of damage. The enhanced attack must be made within 5 rounds (1 minute) of the power strike skill check, or the effect fades.
Power Strike.meta: 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Power Strike.name: Power Strike

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, gains another -1 step bonus and a successful attack inflicts Amazing-quality damage.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, increased Duration - the effect lasts up to 10 rounds or until used.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, increased Damage - gains another -1 step bonus on the next melee attack and successful attack inflicts Good-quality damage.

Power Strike.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 64

Power Swimming.description: Governing Ability: Constitution (CON). Modifiers: Allows the hero to swim at 150% of his normal swim or easy swim movement rate at no FX energy cost. Breathing water and surviving deep pressure does not translate into protection against incoming physical/energy attacks. Each activation lasts 10 minutes. This skill allows the hero to move faster in water or another liquid. The character can also breathe water and survive water pressure at depths as great as 500 meters.
Power Swimming.meta: Cost: 2 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Active or 1 FX energy point (No skill check required)
Power Swimming.name: Power Swimming

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the character's maximum depth and swim rate increase to eight times the base values (requires active tracking of the super power to function).
rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, the character's maximum depth and swim rate increase to two times the base values (requires active tracking of the super power to function).
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, the character's maximum depth and swim rate increase to four times the base values (requires active tracking of the super power to function).
rank_benefits.9: At rank 9, the character's maximum depth and swim rate increase to six times the base values (requires active tracking of the super power to function).

Power Swimming.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 68-69

Programmed response.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: This advanced illusion establishes a complex, localized holographic scenario within a 5-meter radius that reacts dynamically to specific triggers. The illusionist can script an event—such as an illusory guard demanding a password, or a fake wall crumbling to reveal a trap—that activates when an intruder enters the space. The programmed illusion persists passively for up to 24 hours before naturally dissipating if untriggered.
Programmed response.meta: Cost: 5 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Conjure spell (2 FX energy points)
Programmed response.name: Programmed response

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the programmed response can incorporate a minor physical element by triggering a secondary, pre-cast physical trap alongside the sensory illusion.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the illusion can be tied to a specific auditory trigger or time delay.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the maximum passive duration of the untriggered illusion extends to one full week.

Programmed response.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 30

Reciprocating.description: Governing Ability: Constitution (CON). Player Notes: The hemomancer curses a hostile target within 10 meters, creating a violent biological feedback loop between their circulatory systems. The target can attempt to resist with a physical resolve check. If the spell takes hold, for the duration of the scene, any physical wound or mortal damage the hemomancer sustains from an external attack forces the cursed target to immediately suffer a reciprocating physiological shock, taking an equal amount of stun damage.
Reciprocating.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (2 FX energy points)
Reciprocating.name: Reciprocity

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the feedback loop amplifies the trauma; the target suffers the exact amount and type of damage (including mortal damage) that the hemomancer takes.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the reciprocating shock inflicts wound damage instead of stun damage.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the range of the initial curse increases to 20 meters, and the reciprocating damage bypasses standard non-FX armor completely.

Reciprocating.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 20

Rend the weave.description:
What it is: Negates other active magical spells (both Arcane Magic and Faith FX) directed against the caster or a target within 30 meters [i, 78].

Mechanics & Rules: Automatically succeeds against the caster's own magic [i, 78]. Target spells from Enochian or Monotheism schools inflict a +1 step penalty to the check [i, 78]. Requires an Ordinary-quality sacrifice [i, 78].

Combat Profile: Adds a utility **Defense Form** capable of dispelling enemy spells and miracles.
Rend the weave.meta: Cost: 2 skill points / Untrained use permitted / Transform Spell (1 FX energy point)
Rend the weave.name: Rend the weave

rank_benefits.1: Caster Level Advantage: Each rank of difference between the skill rank of the caster and the target spell's caster adds a -1 step bonus (or penalty) to the check.

Rend the weave.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 23

Reward of toil.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: The recipient of the miracle must be touched by the priest. Full Text: This miracle makes it easier to perform tasks that take extensive time or effort, such as working in a farmer's field or traveling overland by foot. The recipient of the miracle enjoys a -1 step bonus on all actions of this type and to any Movement specialty skill checks. She also suffers no fatigue damage for any such efforts made while the miracle is in effect. The miracle lasts 2 hours plus 2 hours for every degree of success of the skill check.

Righteous wrath.description: This miracle fills the priest with divine fury against those who rely on corrupting technology. It grants the priest bonuses to combat skills when fighting opponents wielding high-tech weaponry (PL 4 or higher).
Righteous wrath.name: Righteous wrath

rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, increased Damage: At ranks 4 and 8, the priest inflicts additional damage against technological foes.

Runs cold.description:
What it is: Causes the target's blood flow to violently decelerate, freezing their motor functions and robbing energy from the brain [i, 71].

Shapeshifting.description: This power allows the hero to alter her size and physical features to appear as another creature within their size range. The hero's clothing and gear do not change shape, so they might not fit the new form. The power grants a -2 step bonus to the Deception-disguise skill. The change is strictly cosmetic—the hero gains no special abilities of the form she takes (e.g., gills, wings). The active form lasts 1 hour.
Shapeshifting.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Shapeshifting.name: Shapeshifting

rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, apply an additional +1 step penalty to perception checks made to see through the disguise.
rank_benefits.9: At rank 9, this becomes an additional +2 step penalty.

Shapeshifting.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 59

Shrinking.description: Shrinks the hero and all worn or carried gear. Ability Scores remain unchanged, but the hero initially becomes 25 percent of normal height. Nonflying movement rates and lifting capacity are multiplied by the size change. The hero gains +2 to Strength and Dexterity resistance modifiers, gains a -3 step bonus to Stealth checks, and all melee damage inflicted by the hero is reduced by 4 points. Mass decreases by the cube of the height decrease. The power lasts 10 minutes and size can be changed within the allowed range without extra FX cost.

rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, increased Size Alteration - can shrink to 10 percent of normal height, gaining +3 resistance modifiers, -4 steps to Stealth, and -6 damage.

rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the effects of signs and portents can extend up to 100 meters.

Speak with dead.description: A ritual that summons a spirit from the grave to answer direct inquiries. Summons a specific ghost to answer questions. If the physical corpse is nearby, the caster receives a -2 step bonus to the check; however, they suffer a +1 step penalty for every week that has passed since the target died. Player Notes: This simple spell creates a completely stationary, three-dimensional visual illusion of an object, creature, or landscape feature within a 2-meter cube up to 30 meters away. The image remains fixed in place and stands up to casual inspection from a distance, but does not adjust to changing light conditions or physical contact.

Steal the soul.description: The offensive extraction of a living target's spirit, trapping them inside a container. The caster can violently rip the soul out of a target who is physically restrained within 10 meters of both the caster and a life battery. The victim must roll a Resolve-mental resolve check to resist. On a failure, their life force is extracted and stored in the battery. Body Decay: If the soul is not returned to its physical body within 1 hour, the body begins to die. For every hour the spirit is trapped beyond the first, the body must make a Resolve-physical resolve check or suffer 1 point of Mortal damage. Necromantic Synergy: If a corpse drained via Steal the Soul is subsequently animated, the caster receives a permanent -2 step bonus to their Animate Dead skill check. Combat Forms Added: Attack/Soul-Trap Form: The caster gains a powerful, close-range Attack Form capable of stripping a restrained target's soul and converting it into storable FX energy.

Superior Senses.description: Enhances all senses to a superhuman level. In general, the hero gains a -1 step bonus to any skill check or reduces a sensory-related penalty by one step where improved senses help, such as Manipulation, Awareness-perception, Investigate-search, tracking, poor visibility, or poor illumination. The power lasts 1 hour per degree of success. Attacks specifically targeting the hero's senses, such as bright light or loud noise, gain a bonus equal to the hero's sensory bonus. At acquisition, the player may choose to enhance only one sense, reducing versatility but granting an additional -1 step bonus to that sense, such as -2 for sight-related perception.

Surge of greenery.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: Entanglement Penalties: Moving through the mutating growth requires an Acrobatics-dodge or Movement-trailblazing check to avoid being pinned. Short grass cuts movement by 25%, long grass cuts it by 50%, and heavy brush completely halts all transit. Full Text: This miracle charges plant life within a 20-meter radius with vital energy, triggering hyper-accelerated growth. Plants surge by one month's normal development per skill rank. Lawn grass caps out at 50 cm, but crops/wild grasses rocket past 2 meters; thickets intertwine instantly, and saplings mature drastically, providing heavy cover.

A hostile action is considered to be any action the person to be affected would consider harmful or dangerous. In addition, any individual in this area who does not attempt a hostile action gains +1 to her Strength and Dexterity resistance modifiers. Swords into plowshares lasts for 1 minute (5 rounds).

Talisman.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: This permits the storage of specific spiritual protections or triggers into a localized physical anchor, usually a paper strip or carved tablet. Full Text: The priest transcribes a precise divine pattern onto a physical talisman, anchoring a fraction of their spiritual energy into the object. The talisman can then be attached to a person, doorway, or container to ward off malicious spirits, hexes, or unexpected environmental hazards. The item remains charged until triggered or until the scene concludes.

Tongue of the infinite stars.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Modifiers: Anyone within 10 meters of the miracle's area must make a Resolve-mental resolve skill check with a -2 step bonus or suffer the temporary effects of a Critical Failure on an Alienism miracle check (gain one flaw and lose 1 point of Intelligence for d4 days). If used as an attack against a creature within 30 meters, the target must make a mental resolve check or suffer the same temporary effects (precludes translation effect). This miracle allows open communication between all intelligent creatures within 30 meters of the alienist. All such creatures communicate as if they were speaking the same language, regardless of native form (crystalline entity flashes, volcanic heat patterns, telepathy, etc.). The miracle actually translates each creature's language into a bizarre alien universal language while simultaneously allowing the recipients to comprehend it. Anyone outside the area hears nothing but a strange chaotic babble. The translation ability lasts 1 minute plus 1 minute per degree of success.

Voices in the grass and sky.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: Form 1 (Flora Link): Requires living plants. Can read back 1 hour into the past per skill rank. Form 2 (Astrology): Requires star-tracking instruments (sacred standing stones preferred). Predicts relevant events up to 1 week in advance per skill rank. Cannot read portents for distant lands/planets unless they hold a direct, impending impact on the druid. Full Text: This miracle permits communication with plants or reads the cosmos to interpret the future. The flora path mirrors ESP-postcognition and ESP-psychometry traits, translating a plant’s simple sensory impression of its environment into human comprehension. The cosmic path delivers prophecies: Ordinary success yields vague archetypes (victory, tragedy, war); Good success outlines specific contexts (negotiation win, war with a specific clan); Amazing success reveals the event, context, and symbolic descriptors identifying the exact target.

Wallcrawling.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Modifiers: The gripping strength of this power is equal to the hero's own Strength Ability Score, meaning external forces exceeding this score can detach the character from the surface. Lasts 10 minutes per use. This power allows the hero to move along horizontal or vertical surfaces without penalty at her normal movement rate. The hero can walk, run, or sprint up a wall or hang upside down from a ceiling without fear of falling or the need for handholds. This power can also be used to hold onto smaller solid objects, such as ropes, weapons, or other equipment.
